name: FIM MotoGP World Championship
notes: 11 MotoGP-class teams per the official motogp.com teams page (fetched 2026-09-25); every team name carries its title sponsor.
The official calendar lists 22 rounds for 2026; race title sponsors are shown on motogp.com/en/sponsors, not on the calendar.
The Qatar GP (Lusail) was moved from 10-12 Apr to 6-8 Nov 2026 after the Iran conflict; as of 19 Sep 2026 Dorna was still deciding whether it runs (Crash.net). No Kazakhstan round in 2026.
Sponsor placement here is mapped to the schema's front value from 'team title/name'; bike-livery placements do not fit the schema yet.
